No further news has been received since we heard that he was a P.O.W. in Japan. Frank Halls was posted missing from Anzio. It has since been heard that he was wounded and is now a P.O.W.
Frank Halls, so we learn, was wounded in the legs before his capture. It is feared that he will not be able to race-walk again, but we hope that the prophets are wrong.

News continues to come from Frank Halls who is wounded and a prisoner in Italy, and Arthur Beales, a prisoner in Germany. News also continues to flow in from all parts of the world of our walkers in the Services.

Alf Miller and Arthur Beales were at Stalagluft III at Sagan and were both in good health. Frank Halls was at Stalag 344 at Lansdorf, and his latest news was that his leg was making progress and that he was in good health.
